prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: S3 storage classes trade storage price, retrieval price, minimum duration, availability design, and __________ for different access patterns.

reveal.text: S3 storage classes trade storage price, retrieval price, minimum duration, availability design, and retrieval latency for different access patterns.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use S3 lifecycle rules or Intelligent-Tiering to move data toward __________ as access becomes less frequent or unpredictable.

reveal.text: Use S3 lifecycle rules or Intelligent-Tiering to move data toward lower-cost tiers as access becomes less frequent or unpredictable.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not place frequently read latency-sensitive data in an __________ that requires restore time.

reveal.text: Do not place frequently read latency-sensitive data in an archive class that requires restore time.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Unknown or changing access patterns point to S3 __________; rarely accessed archives point to a Glacier class.

reveal.text: Unknown or changing access patterns point to S3 Intelligent-Tiering; rarely accessed archives point to a Glacier class.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized storage solutions — official exam guide
S3 storage classes and lifecycle — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________ decouples baseline storage size from provisioned IOPS and throughput, while io2 targets demanding IOPS and st1 or sc1 target lower-cost sequential throughput workloads.

reveal.text: gp3 decouples baseline storage size from provisioned IOPS and throughput, while io2 targets demanding IOPS and st1 or sc1 target lower-cost sequential throughput workloads.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Choose the __________ EBS type that still satisfies IOPS, throughput, latency, durability, and boot-volume requirements.

reveal.text: Choose the lowest-cost EBS type that still satisfies IOPS, throughput, latency, durability, and boot-volume requirements.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not pay for __________ when a general-purpose gp3 volume already meets the workload's measured performance.

reveal.text: Do not pay for provisioned IOPS when a general-purpose gp3 volume already meets the workload's measured performance.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A general transactional workload needing configurable IOPS at lower cost than provisioned-IOPS volumes often points to __________.

reveal.text: A general transactional workload needing configurable IOPS at lower cost than provisioned-IOPS volumes often points to gp3.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized storage solutions — official exam guide
Cost-aware EBS selection — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Online services such as DataSync, physical Snow Family devices, and hybrid Storage Gateway patterns have different transfer, time, and operational __________.

reveal.text: Online services such as DataSync, physical Snow Family devices, and hybrid Storage Gateway patterns have different transfer, time, and operational cost profiles.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Estimate dataset size, available bandwidth, migration deadline, recurring transfer pattern, and __________ before selecting a method.

reveal.text: Estimate dataset size, available bandwidth, migration deadline, recurring transfer pattern, and data-transfer charges before selecting a method.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not choose the technically __________ transfer method without checking whether the business deadline actually requires its higher cost.

reveal.text: Do not choose the technically fastest transfer method without checking whether the business deadline actually requires its higher cost.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A one-time very large migration over a severely bandwidth-limited link can make __________ Family more economical than months of network transfer.

reveal.text: A one-time very large migration over a severely bandwidth-limited link can make Snow Family more economical than months of network transfer.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized storage solutions — official exam guide
Cost-aware storage migration and transfer — AWS documentation

nodes.title: On-Demand, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and Spot

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: On-Demand offers flexibility, Savings Plans and Reserved Instances reward committed usage, and Spot uses spare EC2 capacity at steep discounts with __________.

reveal.text: On-Demand offers flexibility, Savings Plans and Reserved Instances reward committed usage, and Spot uses spare EC2 capacity at steep discounts with interruption risk.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use Spot for fault-tolerant interruptible work, commitment discounts for __________ usage, and On-Demand for uncertain or short-lived needs.

reveal.text: Use Spot for fault-tolerant interruptible work, commitment discounts for predictable baseline usage, and On-Demand for uncertain or short-lived needs.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not place a non-interruptible __________ database on Spot solely to reduce compute price.

reveal.text: Do not place a non-interruptible singleton database on Spot solely to reduce compute price.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Interruptible batch work points to __________; steady long-term compute usage points to Savings Plans or Reserved Instances.

reveal.text: Interruptible batch work points to Spot; steady long-term compute usage points to Savings Plans or Reserved Instances.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized compute solutions — official exam guide
On-Demand, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and Spot — AWS documentation

nodes.title: Right-sizing, Auto Scaling, and Compute Optimizer

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Right-sizing matches resource capacity to __________, Auto Scaling adjusts capacity over time, and AWS Compute Optimizer provides recommendations based on utilization data.

reveal.text: Right-sizing matches resource capacity to measured demand, Auto Scaling adjusts capacity over time, and AWS Compute Optimizer provides recommendations based on utilization data.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use measurements and recommendations to reduce chronic overprovisioning, then preserve headroom required by latency and availability __________.

reveal.text: Use measurements and recommendations to reduce chronic overprovisioning, then preserve headroom required by latency and availability objectives.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not downsize solely from __________ if memory, network, I/O, or peak demand is the limiting resource.

reveal.text: Do not downsize solely from average CPU if memory, network, I/O, or peak demand is the limiting resource.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: An underutilized fleet with stable metrics is a right-sizing and __________ opportunity.

reveal.text: An underutilized fleet with stable metrics is a right-sizing and Compute Optimizer opportunity.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized compute solutions — official exam guide
Right-sizing, Auto Scaling, and Compute Optimizer — AWS documentation

nodes.title: Lambda, Fargate, and EC2 cost trade-offs

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Lambda charges for requests and __________, Fargate charges for provisioned task resources, and EC2 charges for instance capacity with purchasing-model options.

reveal.text: Lambda charges for requests and execution resources, Fargate charges for provisioned task resources, and EC2 charges for instance capacity with purchasing-model options.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Compare __________, utilization, execution duration, scaling pattern, operational effort, and commitment discounts instead of assuming one compute model is always cheaper.

reveal.text: Compare duty cycle, utilization, execution duration, scaling pattern, operational effort, and commitment discounts instead of assuming one compute model is always cheaper.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not keep an __________ EC2 fleet only for occasional short event-driven work when serverless options meet the workload requirements.

reveal.text: Do not keep an always-idle EC2 fleet only for occasional short event-driven work when serverless options meet the workload requirements.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Very spiky short-lived event processing often favors __________, while continuously utilized services can favor containers or EC2.

reveal.text: Very spiky short-lived event processing often favors Lambda, while continuously utilized services can favor containers or EC2.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized compute solutions — official exam guide
Lambda, Fargate, and EC2 cost trade-offs — AWS documentation

nodes.title: RDS, Aurora Serverless, and DynamoDB cost models

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Managed relational databases charge for database __________ and storage, Aurora Serverless can adjust relational capacity, and DynamoDB offers on-demand or provisioned capacity for key-value workloads.

reveal.text: Managed relational databases charge for database capacity and storage, Aurora Serverless can adjust relational capacity, and DynamoDB offers on-demand or provisioned capacity for key-value workloads.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Match cost model to __________: variable relational demand can fit Aurora Serverless, while unpredictable key-value traffic can fit DynamoDB on-demand.

reveal.text: Match cost model to access pattern: variable relational demand can fit Aurora Serverless, while unpredictable key-value traffic can fit DynamoDB on-demand.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not move a relational workload that depends on __________ and transactions to DynamoDB solely because serverless billing sounds cheaper.

reveal.text: Do not move a relational workload that depends on joins and transactions to DynamoDB solely because serverless billing sounds cheaper.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Unpredictable key-value traffic with no capacity planning preference points to DynamoDB __________.

reveal.text: Unpredictable key-value traffic with no capacity planning preference points to DynamoDB on-demand.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized database solutions — official exam guide
RDS, Aurora Serverless, and DynamoDB cost models — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: A cache can absorb repeated reads and __________ CPU, I/O, and capacity requirements when the workload has cacheable access patterns.

reveal.text: A cache can absorb repeated reads and reduce database CPU, I/O, and capacity requirements when the workload has cacheable access patterns.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use ElastiCache for general application caching or DAX for suitable DynamoDB read workloads when __________ can justify the added cache cost.

reveal.text: Use ElastiCache for general application caching or DAX for suitable DynamoDB read workloads when cache hit rate can justify the added cache cost.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not add a cache to a __________ or low-reuse workload when it adds cost and complexity without meaningful offload.

reveal.text: Do not add a cache to a write-only or low-reuse workload when it adds cost and complexity without meaningful offload.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A read-heavy workload repeatedly requesting the same data can often lower database load by __________ hot results.

reveal.text: A read-heavy workload repeatedly requesting the same data can often lower database load by caching hot results.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized database solutions — official exam guide
Caching to reduce database cost — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Backup frequency and retention determine recovery coverage and __________, so retention should match business and compliance requirements.

reveal.text: Backup frequency and retention determine recovery coverage and storage consumption, so retention should match business and compliance requirements.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Keep the recovery points the business requires and __________ obsolete snapshots or backups according to policy.

reveal.text: Keep the recovery points the business requires and expire obsolete snapshots or backups according to policy.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not retain every manual snapshot __________ when no legal, recovery, or business requirement justifies the storage cost.

reveal.text: Do not retain every manual snapshot forever when no legal, recovery, or business requirement justifies the storage cost.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A large collection of old unneeded snapshots is a __________-policy optimization opportunity.

reveal.text: A large collection of old unneeded snapshots is a retention-policy optimization opportunity.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized database solutions — official exam guide
Database backups and retention cost — AWS documentation

nodes.title: NAT gateway and VPC endpoint cost trade-offs

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: NAT gateways incur hourly and __________, while VPC endpoints can keep supported service traffic private and may reduce NAT data processing for that traffic.

reveal.text: NAT gateways incur hourly and data-processing charges, while VPC endpoints can keep supported service traffic private and may reduce NAT data processing for that traffic.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use an S3 or DynamoDB __________ when private workloads frequently access those services and do not need NAT for that traffic.

reveal.text: Use an S3 or DynamoDB gateway endpoint when private workloads frequently access those services and do not need NAT for that traffic.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not route high-volume S3 traffic through a __________ when a gateway VPC endpoint satisfies the access requirement.

reveal.text: Do not route high-volume S3 traffic through a NAT gateway when a gateway VPC endpoint satisfies the access requirement.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Large private-subnet S3 traffic plus NAT data-processing cost points to an __________.

reveal.text: Large private-subnet S3 traffic plus NAT data-processing cost points to an S3 gateway endpoint.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized network architectures — official exam guide
NAT gateway and VPC endpoint cost trade-offs — AWS documentation

nodes.title: Data transfer and edge caching cost

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Architecture choices that keep traffic local or serve cacheable content from __________ can reduce origin load and some data-transfer paths.

reveal.text: Architecture choices that keep traffic local or serve cacheable content from edge locations can reduce origin load and some data-transfer paths.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ when globally distributed users repeatedly request cacheable content from an origin such as S3 or an ALB.

reveal.text: Use CloudFront when globally distributed users repeatedly request cacheable content from an origin such as S3 or an ALB.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not force every global request back to the __________ when edge caching can satisfy repeated reads.

reveal.text: Do not force every global request back to the origin when edge caching can satisfy repeated reads.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: High global egress plus highly cacheable content is a __________ cost and performance opportunity.

reveal.text: High global egress plus highly cacheable content is a CloudFront cost and performance opportunity.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized network architectures — official exam guide
Data transfer and edge caching cost — AWS documentation

nodes.title: Peering, Transit Gateway, VPN, and Direct Connect cost

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: VPC peering, Transit Gateway, Site-to-Site VPN, and Direct Connect have different topology, bandwidth, operational, and data-processing __________.

reveal.text: VPC peering, Transit Gateway, Site-to-Site VPN, and Direct Connect have different topology, bandwidth, operational, and data-processing cost characteristics.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use peering for simpler point-to-point connectivity, Transit Gateway for scalable __________ routing, VPN for internet-based encrypted connectivity, and Direct Connect for dedicated connectivity.

reveal.text: Use peering for simpler point-to-point connectivity, Transit Gateway for scalable hub-and-spoke routing, VPN for internet-based encrypted connectivity, and Direct Connect for dedicated connectivity.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not build a large __________ peering topology when centralized transit is required and operational complexity dominates.

reveal.text: Do not build a large full-mesh peering topology when centralized transit is required and operational complexity dominates.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Dozens of VPCs requiring centralized routing usually point to __________ rather than a peering mesh.

reveal.text: Dozens of VPCs requiring centralized routing usually point to Transit Gateway rather than a peering mesh.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized network architectures — official exam guide
Peering, Transit Gateway, VPN, and Direct Connect cost — AWS documentation

nodes.title: Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR, and cost allocation tags

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Cost Explorer analyzes spend and usage trends, AWS Budgets tracks thresholds and forecasts, Cost and Usage Report provides __________, and cost allocation tags attribute spend to resources.

reveal.text: Cost Explorer analyzes spend and usage trends, AWS Budgets tracks thresholds and forecasts, Cost and Usage Report provides detailed billing data, and cost allocation tags attribute spend to resources.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use the tool that matches the question: exploration and trends, proactive __________, detailed line-item analysis, or cost attribution.

reveal.text: Use the tool that matches the question: exploration and trends, proactive thresholds, detailed line-item analysis, or cost attribution.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not expect AWS Budgets alone to provide the __________ raw billing dataset as the Cost and Usage Report.

reveal.text: Do not expect AWS Budgets alone to provide the same granular raw billing dataset as the Cost and Usage Report.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Alert when forecast spend exceeds a monthly target points to AWS __________; detailed billing exports point to Cost and Usage Report.

reveal.text: Alert when forecast spend exceeds a monthly target points to AWS Budgets; detailed billing exports point to Cost and Usage Report.

source_refs.title: Design cost-optimized network architectures — official exam guide
Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR, and cost allocation tags — AWS documentation
